title: Joining a public library
intro: Part 1. You will hear a woman talking to a library assistant because she wants to join the library.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to Marsh Hill Library. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: Hello. I'd like to join the library, please. I've just started working at the bakery across the road, and I thought I could borrow a few books in my lunch break.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Good idea. It only takes a few minutes, and I'll type your details straight into the computer. Can I have your full name, please?

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: Yes, it's Nadia Rossiter. That's R, O, double S, I, T, E, R.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Thank you. And your date of birth?

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: The ninth of November, nineteen ninety-six.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Sorry, did you say the fifth? It's a bit noisy at the desk today.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: No, the ninth. Nine.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Got it. And what's your address?

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: Well, my driving licence still has my old address in Leeds, but I moved down here last month. The new one is Flat 2, 31 Wellbrook Street. That's W, E, double L, B, R, O, O, K. It's in Kingsbury.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Kingsbury? That's just outside our borough, but don't worry, I'll come back to that. Can I take a phone number?

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: Sure. My mobile is 0 7 7 0 0, 9 0 0 2 7 4. Oh, sorry, I always do that. The end is 4 7, not 7 4. So that's 0 7 7 0 0, 9 0 0 2 4 7.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Thanks. Now, I'll also need to see something with your new address on it. Have you got anything with you?

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: I've got my phone bill here. Will that do?

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: I'm afraid we can't accept mobile phone bills. It needs to be a bank statement, or a bill for gas, water or electricity.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: Oh, hang on. I haven't brought a bank statement, but I've got a water bill in my bag. It only arrived yesterday. Here you are.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: That's fine. Now, about the fee. Membership is free for anyone who lives in the borough, but as you live in Kingsbury, it would normally be £15 a year.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: Oh, I didn't realise there was a charge.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Hold on, though. You said you work at the bakery across the road, didn't you? In that case, you can have the reduced rate for people who work in the borough. That's only £8.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: That's great. I'll pay by card, if that's OK.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Of course. Right, here's your card. Now, let me quickly explain how borrowing works. You can take out up to 15 items at a time, and that includes DVDs and audiobooks.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: And how long can I keep them?

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Three weeks. After that, you can renew them online twice, as long as nobody else has reserved them.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: Brilliant. Do you have any book clubs? I used to belong to one in Leeds.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Yes, there's a reading group. It used to meet on Tuesday evenings, but too many people had other classes that night, so now it meets on the first Wednesday of each month, at seven.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: I'll definitely come along. And can I use the computers?

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: Yes, members can use them free for up to two hours a day. We used to lend out headphones, but we stopped doing that last winter, so if you want to watch videos, please bring your own headphones.

segments.speaker: nadia
segments.text: No problem. Thanks so much for your help.

segments.speaker: owen
segments.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your books.

questions.explanation: Nadia 逐个字母拼出 R, O, double S, I, T, E, R。double S 表示两个 s，写成 Rositer 判错。
店员没听清，问是不是 the fifth（干扰），Nadia 纠正 No, the ninth。以纠正后的为准，写 9、9th 或 ninth 都算对。
驾照上的 Leeds 旧地址是干扰，填新地址的街名。Nadia 拼出 W, E, double L, B, R, O, O, K，注意两个 l 和两个 o。
她先说成 900274，马上改口：结尾是 4 7 不是 7 4，正确号码是 900247。前缀 07700 题目已给出。请写成连续的 6 位数字：本系统按空格切分计数，写成 900 247 会被算作两个数字而超出字数限制。
手机账单（phone bill）不被接受（干扰）；店员列出 gas、water、electricity 都可以，Nadia 实际拿出的是 water bill。
住在辖区外通常一年 £15（干扰）；店员随后想起她在本区工作，可以享受优惠价，只要 £8。题目已给出 £，写 8 或 £8 都算对。

questions.heading: Borrowing
questions.prompt: Up to ___ items at a time, including DVDs
questions.explanation: You can take out up to 15 items at a time，包括 DVD 和有声书。写 15 或 fifteen 都算对。

questions.prompt: Loan period: ___ weeks (can renew online twice)
questions.explanation: 借期 three weeks，之后可以在网上续借两次（twice 是续借次数，不是借期）。

questions.heading: Other services
questions.prompt: Reading group: first ___ of each month, 7 pm
questions.explanation: 读书会以前在周二晚上（used to 提示过去，干扰），现在改到每月第一个周三晚七点。注意拼写 Wednesday 中间的 d 不发音。

questions.prompt: Computers: free for 2 hours a day; bring your own ___
questions.explanation: 图书馆去年冬天起不再出借耳机，想看视频要自带 headphones。注意是复数。

title: Getting a quote for a house move
titleCn: 电话咨询搬家公司报价
intro: Part 1. You will hear a man phoning a removal company to get a price for moving house.

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Good morning, Swift Move Removals. Joanne speaking. How can I help?

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Hello. I'm moving house next month, and I'd like to get a quote, please.

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Certainly. I'll just take a few details first. Could I have your name?

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Yes, it's Tom Whitcombe. That's W, H, I, T, C, O, M, B, E.

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Thank you, Mr Whitcombe. And where are you moving from, and where to?

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: From 18 Larch Close, here in Bramford, to a village called Holmbury. That's H, O, L, M, B, U, R, Y. The new address is 5 Mill Lane.

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Lovely. And what's the best number to call you on during the day?

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Please don't use my mobile, because the signal in my office is terrible. My work number is better. It's 0 1 6 3 2, 9 6 0 3 1 8.

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Thanks. And have you got a date for the move yet?

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: It was going to be Friday the 14th of August, but the people buying our house have asked for another week, so now it's Friday the 21st.

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: OK, I'll put down the 21st. And how big is the house?

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: It's got three bedrooms. Most of it is ordinary furniture, but there are a couple of things I'm worried about. There's a large antique mirror, but actually, I'll take that myself in the car. The thing I really need help with is my grandmother's piano.

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: That's no problem at all. We move pianos every week. So, for a three-bedroom house, our standard price is £580. The piano adds another £60, so the total comes to £640.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: That sounds reasonable. Does that include packing boxes?

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Yes, it does. We deliver up to 40 boxes free of charge a week before the move. We used to give 30, but people always ran out.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Great. And how do I pay?

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: We ask for a deposit of 10 per cent when you book, and then you pay the rest on the day of the move.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Fine. Is there anything I need to organise myself?

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Just one thing. Our lorry is quite big, so if there's no driveway, you'll need a parking permit from the council. Some people just put cones out in the street, but that isn't allowed.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: There's a driveway at the new house, but not here, so I'll apply for one. Anything else?

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Yes. Our team can't carry anything that might catch fire, so please don't pack any tins of paint. Plants are fine, by the way, as long as they're in pots.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Got it. Could you email the quote to me?

segments.speaker: joanne
segments.text: Of course. You'll have it within the hour. Thanks for calling, Mr Whitcombe.

questions.explanation: Tom 拼出 W, H, I, T, C, O, M, B, E。注意开头是 Wh，结尾 -combe 里的 b 和 e 都要写出来。
Bramford 是现在住的地方（干扰），新地址在村子 Holmbury。按 H, O, L, M, B, U, R, Y 拼写，注意 Holm 里的 l 不要漏。
Tom 说办公室手机信号差，别打手机，要用工作电话。区号 01632 题目已给出，后面是 960318。请写成连续的 6 位数字，写成 960 318 会被本系统算作两个数字而超出字数限制。
原定 14 号（干扰），买家要求推迟一周，现在是 21 号。写 21、21st 或 twenty-first 都算对。
古董镜子（mirror）他自己开车运（干扰），真正需要帮忙的是祖母的钢琴 piano。
三居室标准价 £580、钢琴加价 £60 都是干扰，问的是总价 the total comes to £640。

groups.wordLimit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.title: Before moving day

questions.heading: Included in the price
questions.prompt: Up to ___ free boxes, delivered a week before the move
questions.explanation: 以前送 30 个（used to，干扰），现在最多免费送 40 个箱子。写 40 或 forty 都算对。

questions.heading: Payment
questions.prompt: Deposit of ___ per cent when booking
questions.explanation: 预订时付 10 per cent 定金，余款搬家当天付。题目已给出 per cent，只填数字。

questions.heading: Customer's responsibilities
questions.prompt: Get a parking ___ from the council
questions.explanation: 没有车道时要向市政申请 parking permit（停车许可）；在路边放锥桶是不允许的（干扰）。
搬运工不能搬易燃物品，所以不要打包 tins of paint（油漆罐）。盆栽植物可以搬（干扰）。
